projects.name: Traffic Signal Detection
projects.description: • Developed a computer vision project for traffic signal detection suitable for intelligent transportation or ADAS -oriented experimentation.

projects.name: Benchmarking of Keypoints Detection
projects.description: • Developing deep learning models using several architectures such as RSN, MSPN, YOLO-NAS to identify keypoints.

projects.name: Requirement to Test Cases Generation Using LLM
projects.description:
• Built LLM+RAG agent to auto-generate test cases from requirements.
• Created ingestion pipeline and implemented chunking, embedding, and retrieval workflows for CSV, PDF, Excel documents. Along with that added image processing for infotainment UI screenshots.
• Developed chatbot interface for test case refinement and reduced manual test design effort with multimodal inputs.

projects.name: Realtime PPE Detection
projects.description:
• Built a real-time personal protective equipment detection project for safety monitoring in industrial environments.
• Developed Streamlit UI for real-time model validation.

projects.name: Benchmarking Motion Planning Algorithm
projects.description:
• Motion Planning of 6DoF robot manipulator using benchmark ROS2 and MoveIt2 motion planning algorithms.
• Benchmarking different motion planning algorithms such as RRT, RRT Connect for pick and place operation.

projects.name: MCP Weather Service
projects.description:
• Built MCP-based weather service for LLM tool-calling and AI agent integration.
• Created Gradio-MCP server UI for tool execution and user interaction.

projects.name: Development of Vision-Based Platform
projects.description:
• Previously defect detection taking 10 -15 minutes manually, now the entire process is completed within 3secs.
• Developing deep learning -based models to identify defects for multi -class object detection and semantic segmentation using YOLOV8 and encoder-decoder based architecture.
• Developing Python -based data pipelines to efficiently extract and analyze real -time data, and enhancing production monitoring and decision making.
• Developing microservices with gRPC connections for seamless communication.
• Managing deployments on Azure cloud with Docker containerization, ensuring system reliability and scalability.
• Deployment of deep learning models using Triton Inference Server with ensemble structure.

projects.name: Intelligent Networked Robotic Systems
projects.description:
• Developed neural network -based path planning algorithms for multiple Unmanned Ground Vehicles in a grid -based environment.
• Developed an intelligent control framework for multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to achieve and maintain the formation under external disturbances for directed and undirected network topologies.

ARINDAM SINGHA 
Chatripara, Sainthia, Birbhum, West Bengal - 731234

SUMMARY
 
Robotics and AI researcher with a Ph.D. in Networked Robotics and proven expertise in developing intelligent 
algorithms, multi-agent control systems for both Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and Unmanned Ground Vehicle 
(UGV) systems, and deep learning solutio ns. Skilled in computer vision, large language models (LLMs), retrieval -
augmented generation (RAG), and advanced model deployment pipelines. Hands -on experience in MLOps, cloud 
services, and robotics frameworks (ROS2, MoveIt2, NAV2). Recognized for develop ing scalable AI solutions, 
integrating ML models into robotic workflows, and driving innovation across research and industry projects. Developed 
and delivered one microservice -based end-to-end platform to production on vision -based deep learning architectu re. 
Delivered one end-to-end project to production on ML & computer vision.

Ph.D. (National Institute of Technology Sikkim) 
Intelligent Networked Robotic Systems                                    2016 - 2021 
M.E. (Thapar University) 
Electronics Instrumentation & Control                          2012 - 2014 
B.Tech (Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management, MAKAUT) 
Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering                       2008 - 2012 
SKILLS
 
Reinforcement Learning: MDP, Actor-Critic, PPO, MADT3 
Frameworks & Tools: ROS2, Langchain, LangGraph, Triton Inference Service, MCP 
ML/DL Expertise:  YOLOv3/v4/v8, Transformers, Computer Vision, Semantic Segmentation, Keypoint Detection, 
LLMs, RAG, AI Agent, Agentic RAG, MCP

Triton Inference Server, CI/CD pipelines, MLFlow, Dev-Container, DVC, Databricks

Lead Engineer 
Magna Steyr India, Pune                    07/2024 – Present 
• Developing deep learning-based models to identify defects for multi -class object detection and semantic segmentation

monitoring and decision making.

National Institute of Technology Sikkim, Sikkim                 01/2016 - 12/2017
